svg.text: Midterm Examination (50 MCQ + T/F + Short Answer)
Use a dark pencil or black pen. Fill each bubble completely. Do not fold or staple this sheet. · bio101-midterm-50

g.text: Write your 8-digit ID no. clearly in the boxes above. Part I & II: fill each bubble completely with a dark pencil or pen.
Part III: print your answer clearly in block capital letters inside the answer box corresponding to each question number.
